method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Urate-lowering therapy: allopurinol, febuxostat, target serum urate, titration
topic.coverageNote: In-app NICE NG219 recommendations chapter (question-repair source import, guideline document for https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng219). Dose-step tables from the evidence reviews are not in the stored chapter.

mcqs.question: What serum urate target does NG219 say to aim for?

options.C: Any fall from baseline, with no numeric target
options.E: Normalisation of CRP rather than urate

mcqs.explanation: Aim for a target serum urate level below 360 micromol/litre (6 mg/dl).

sourceRefs.excerpt: Aim for a target serum urate level below 360 micromol/litre (6 mg/dl).

mcqs.question: When does NG219 say to consider a target below 300 micromol/litre (5 mg/dl)?

options.A: Tophi, chronic gouty arthritis, or ongoing frequent flares despite a urate already below 360
options.B: Every patient at the start of treatment

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Tophi, chronic gouty arthritis, or ongoing frequent flares despite a urate already below 360
mcqs.explanation: Consider a lower target below 300 micromol/litre (5 mg/dl) for tophi, chronic gouty arthritis, or ongoing frequent flares despite a serum urate already below 360.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Consider a lower target serum urate level below 300 micromol/litre (5 mg/dl) for people with gout who: have tophi or chronic gouty arthritis continue to have ongoing frequent flares despite having a serum urate level below 360 micromol/litre (6 mg/dl).

mcqs.question: Which drugs does NG219 offer as first-line treat-to-target urate-lowering therapy?

options.A: Either allopurinol or febuxostat, accounting for comorbidities and preferences

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Either allopurinol or febuxostat, accounting for comorbidities and preferences
mcqs.explanation: Offer either allopurinol or febuxostat as first-line treatment when starting treat-to-target ULT, taking comorbidities and preferences into account.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Offer either allopurinol or febuxostat as first-line treatment when starting treat-to-target ULT, taking into account the person's comorbidities and preferences.

mcqs.question: Which urate-lowering drug does NG219 say to offer first-line in major cardiovascular disease?
mcqs.explanation: Offer allopurinol as first-line treatment to people with gout and major cardiovascular disease, with examples including previous myocardial infarction, stroke, or unstable angina.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Offer allopurinol as first-line treatment to people with gout who have major cardiovascular disease (for example, previous myocardial infarction or stroke, or unstable angina).

mcqs.question: How should the dose be titrated?

options.A: Start low and use monthly serum urate levels to guide increases until the target is reached
options.B: Start at the maximum dose and reduce if the urate is low
options.C: Check serum urate once a year during titration
options.D: Do not change the dose after the first prescription
options.E: Titrate to a creatinine target rather than a urate target

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Start low and use monthly serum urate levels to guide increases until the target is reached
mcqs.explanation: Start with a low dose and use monthly serum urate levels to guide dose increases, as tolerated, until the target serum urate is reached. ULT is usually continued after the target is reached and is typically lifelong.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Start with a low dose of ULT and use monthly serum urate levels to guide dose increases, as tolerated, until the target serum urate level is reached.
